name: S.T.A.L.K.E.R.: Call of Pripyat
publisher: GSC World Publishing / Deep Silver / bitComposer Games

locations.note: SBU Major Degtyarev starts at the Skadovsk, a grounded ship in the Zaton backwater, searching for the helicopters of Operation Fairway that all crashed on the way to the power plant.
The abandoned Yanov station is the second stalker base, a cease-fire zone shared by rival factions.
In the Jupiter area Degtyarev learns that the helicopters were brought down by electrical shocks and finds an underground passage into sealed-off Pripyat.
In Pripyat he finds the surviving soldiers and Strelok, and fights with them to the evacuation helicopters, where he can choose to leave the Zone or stay.

routes.name: Major Degtyarev
routes.note: From the Skadovsk in Zaton to Yanov station and the Jupiter plant, and through the underground passage into Pripyat for the evacuation.
